updates.program_name: ACS Petroleum Research Fund Doctoral New Investigator (DNI) Grants
updates.submission_requirements: TECHNICAL PROPOSAL: a single PDF containing title, abstract, scientific narrative, references and all figures/tables. Double-spaced, 12-point, 1-inch margins. Narrative limited to 4,000 words; title, abstract, references and figure/table captions do not count. The word count must be stated at the end of the narrative. References go in the same PDF, with ALL authors and complete article titles listed — truncated author lists or shortened titles are not acceptable. WORD-LIMITED STATEMENTS: abstract 250; Petroleum Relevance Statement 100; New Research Direction Statement 500; Scientific Education Impact and Mentoring Statement 500; Available Facilities and Instrumentation 500. Plus a Safety Statement describing risks and mitigations. REVIEWERS: the applicant must suggest a MINIMUM OF 6 reviewers (name, institution, email). Conflicts barred: current or recent collaborators or co-authors (within 48 months), former advisors or advisees, colleagues at the PI's or Co-PI's institution, family, and anyone with a personal or financial relationship. Reviewers to exclude may also be named. BUDGET CAPS: PI support max $8,000 per grant year; capital equipment max $5,000 over the project; conference travel max $2,000 per grant year; publication fees max $2,000 over the project. A budget justification narrative is required. ALSO: a similarity/plagiarism check acknowledgement, and a description of how AI tools were used if their use is disclosed. DNI-SPECIFIC: a COMPLETE publication and presentation list is required (not the 5-year list used for ND/UR). The New Research Direction Statement must show the project is distinct from the PI's graduate or postdoctoral research. Postdoctoral fellow salary support is an allowable budget line for DNI. No Co-PI is permitted (Co-PIs are ND and UR only). No teaching information section (UR and UNI only). Source: ACS PRF Grant Application Components (Fall 2026), prf-application-components-fall-2026.pdf
updates.resubmission_policy: Limited to an initial application plus a maximum of TWO resubmissions on the same topic. A resubmission must include a Resubmission Justification / Statement of Modifications describing what changed. Reviewers named on a prior submission may not be suggested again.

updates.program_name: AFRI Education & Workforce Development — Predoctoral Fellowships (A7101)
updates.submission_requirements: Applications are solicited under the program area priorities of the AFRI Education and Workforce Development (AFRI-EWD) Notice of Funding Opportunity; each NOFO carries its own preparation and submission instructions, eligibility and review criteria, so the NOFO is the operative document rather than any standing guide. ELIGIBILITY DOCUMENTATION: the applicant must have advanced to candidacy (as determined by the institution's own requirements) BY THE APPLICATION DEADLINE, and must supply documentation of that from the institution — usually the advisor, the department, or the graduate programs office. That letter is a slow-to-obtain item. NOTE: a Letter of Intent is required for AFRI WORKSHOP grants, not for fellowship grants. Source: NIFA, AFRI Project and Grant Types FAQ (January 2026).
updates.notes_append: Submission requirements added 2026-09-18 (P8) from USDA NIFA's 'AFRI Project and Grant Types FAQ' (January 2026), supplied by the user. FASE SET-ASIDE: 3.75% of the AFRI funds available for grants each year is allocated to pre- and post-doctoral fellowship grants — a real denominator where `selectivity` is otherwise unspecified. Resubmission is not addressed in the FAQ and stays `unspecified`.

updates.program_name: AFRI Education & Workforce Development — Postdoctoral Fellowships (A7201)
updates.submission_requirements: Applications are solicited under the program area priorities of the AFRI Education and Workforce Development (AFRI-EWD) Notice of Funding Opportunity; each NOFO carries its own preparation and submission instructions, eligibility and review criteria, so the NOFO is the operative document. ELIGIBILITY WINDOW: the doctoral degree must have been conferred no earlier than the date specified in the NOFO (keyed to the application deadline) and no later than the date the AFRI-EWD NOFO specifies — a two-sided window that moves each cycle, so it must be read from the live NOFO rather than assumed. NOTE: a Letter of Intent is required for AFRI WORKSHOP grants, not for fellowship grants. Source: NIFA, AFRI Project and Grant Types FAQ (January 2026).
